items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: I used to talk to Max Roach and Bud Powell about certain things.

ctx.x: How was Max Roach in those days at Birdland that you're talking about? He had a period in which he was very upset and disturbed.

Yes, we were talking about that in Kansas City the other day. Something happened to him to change him around and he was very disturbed and upset and used to get in a lot of things. Now he's a very nice guy. I used to talk to Max Roach and Bud Powell about certain things. See, Max doesn't understand about a cross or anything.
